title: India's crude steel output just hit a new high for September - and demand is growing even faster
sources: SteelOrbis - India's crude steel output up 3.4% in Sept 2026, remains net finished steel importer in H1 FY 2026-27
New Kerala - India's raw steel output rises 3.4 pc YoY
caption:
India's crude steel output just hit a new high for September. And demand is growing even faster than supply.

India's crude steel output rose 3.4% year-on-year to 14.1 million tonnes in September 2026, per Ministry of Steel data. For H1 FY27 (April-September), crude steel output reached 85.1 million tonnes, up 2.9%, while finished steel consumption grew even faster - up 7.5% to 84.9 million tonnes. That faster demand growth means India remained a net importer of finished steel this period, even as both imports and exports rose.

Production is climbing. Demand is climbing faster. That gap is the real story.

Sources: SteelOrbis, New Kerala, citing Ministry of Steel data (2026)
